about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Ziyang, a full-stack engineer who believes good interfaces should be both beautiful and genuinely usable.
Outside of code, I'm just a gamer who enjoys life, and believes in good vibes.

items.company: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute
items.desc: Lead the design system, pushed Core Web Vitals across the board, and mentor a 4-person frontend squad.

desc: Built a PySide6 screen recorder capturing video and user actions across Windows apps (Word, Excel, Chrome, Edge, Firefox) with timestamped event logs.
Integrated Playwright to align video frames with UI actions and DOM selectors, generating paired training data (frame + action sequence) for VLM fine-tuning.
OCR Model (PyTorch + FastAPI): Fine-tuned TrOCR with a synthetic image data generator server (diverse fonts + noise injection) to improve real-world generalization without manual labelling
Frontend (Flutter): Built responsive Flutter app targeting Web + iOS with MVVM (Provider); implemented caching strategies and WebSocket for real-time OCR status updates.

Backend (Node.js + MongoDB): Designed RESTful APIs with chunked uploads for large PDFs, Bull queue for async OCR job scheduling, and worker pool for parallel page processing—achieving 1,000+ docs/hour with 99.9% uptime and 35% faster queries.
As the first project at the company, rapidly onboarded Flutter with MVVM architecture (Provider) and MongoDB to design and deliver a responsive model monitoring dashboard.
Designed and implemented unit and integration tests, utilizing dependency injections and mocking to verify page navigation and widget states.
Drafted the whitepaper: Federated Learning: Unlocking Innovation in the Insurance Sector

items.desc: Shipped multiple 0-to-1 consumer products and a component library; averaged 55% first-paint improvement.

projects.desc: Designed the streaming pipeline UI from scratch — adopted by 3 research teams internally.

items.desc: Built internal admin systems, extracted reusable business components, and set the team a11y standard.
